Interfaces 40§

Serializer public APISqlSemanticsWrites a statement's structure as SQL in a chosen layout.

FunctionReferenceSqlSemantics\Model\Scalar\FunctionA named function reference, resolved against registered signatures when available. @visibility public

ServerInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\ForeignChecks the identity and literal domains of PostgreSQL foreign servers.

RangeBound public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\PartitionThe exclusive upper bound of a RANGE partition; MAXVALUE stands for a bound above every value.
SubpartitionDefinition public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\PartitionOne named subpartition of a partition, with its storage options.
TablePartitioning public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\PartitionA complete MySQL PARTITION BY clause: the function, partition and subpartition counts, and explicit partitions. RANGE and LIST require explicit partitions with matching values, HASH and KEY take no values, and only RANGE and LIST subpartition.

CheckPartitions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\PartitionChangeChecks selected partitions with explicitly requested checks.

DropPartitions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\PartitionChangeRemoves named partitions together with their rows.

RepairPartitions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\PartitionChangeRepairs selected partitions with explicitly requested repair modes.

RenameTable public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\TableMoves the altered table to a new name, possibly in another database.
RepartitionTable public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\MySqlTable\TableReplaces the partitioning of the altered table (a trailing PARTITION BY clause).

RoleExclusion public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\PrivilegeWITH ROLE ALL EXCEPT r1: every granted role except the named ones.

ColumnPrivilege public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Privilege\PostgreSqlSELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, REFERENCES, or ALL PRIVILEGES restricted to named columns of tables.

PrivilegeInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Privilege\PostgreSqlEnforces the privilege domains PostgreSQL defines for each object class.

ColumnInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\ColumnShared operand rules of column-level alterations.

TemplateSelection public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\ForeignOne INCLUDING or EXCLUDING choice of a LIKE clause; later choices override earlier ones.

DropColumnIdentity public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\IdentityRemoves the identity property of one column, keeping the column itself.
IdentityInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\IdentitySequence values are PostgreSQL integer literals of arbitrary precision.

DetachPartition public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\PartitionDetaches a partition into a standalone table.
HashPartitionBound public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\PartitionSelects the rows whose hash remainder modulo the modulus equals the remainder.
ListPartitionBound public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\PartitionSelects the rows whose partition key equals one of the listed values.
PartitionInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\PartitionPartition bound values are PostgreSQL expressions.
RangePartitionBound public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\PartitionSelects the rows whose partition key lies from the lower bound up to, excluding, the upper bound.

RuleInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\RuleThe rule shapes PostgreSQL's rewrite system accepts.

SetForeignOptions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\StorageAdds, replaces, or removes foreign-data wrapper options of a foreign table.

SetStorageParameters public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\StorageSets one or more storage parameters of the relation.
SetTablespace public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Relation\StorageMoves the relation into another tablespace.

PublicationOptions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Replication\PublicationThe WITH options of a publication; a null option is not specified and keeps its default or current value.

SubscriptionInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Replication\SubscriptionThe subscription identity, publication-list, and option rules PostgreSQL applies within one command.
SubscriptionOptions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Replication\SubscriptionThe WITH options of a subscription command; a null option is not specified and keeps its default or current value.
ClearedPassword public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleRemoves a role's password; PASSWORD NULL carries no secret to retain.
ConnectionLimit public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleThe number of concurrent connections a role may open; -1 removes the limit.
RoleAdmins public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleRoles that become members of the new role with the admin option.
RoleAttribute public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleGrants or withholds one role capability; NOLOGIN is the withheld form of LOGIN.
RoleInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleEnforces PostgreSQL role operand domains shared by definitions, alterations, and settings.
RoleMembers public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleRoles that become members of the new role; ROLE and USER lists are the same request.
RoleMemberships public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleExisting roles the new role joins; IN ROLE and IN GROUP are the same request.
RolePassword public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleA password supplied as a text literal; binding never hashes or stores it.
RoleSystemId public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleA legacy SYSID request; PostgreSQL accepts and ignores it, so it is retained as written.
RoleValidity public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoleThe timestamp text after which a role's password stops working, kept as written.
AggregateParameter public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineAn argument's declared type, direction, optional name, and set-valued type request.
ArgumentTypeInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineEnforces PostgreSQL argument-type declarations and compares variadic type requests.
ColumnTypeReference public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineA PostgreSQL column-type reference, with its declaration when the schema resolves it.
OrderedSetAggregate public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineSelects an ordered-set aggregate with separate direct and aggregated argument declarations.
OrdinaryAggregate public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineSelects an aggregate by a nonempty list of aggregated input declarations.
RoutineByName public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineSelects the unique routine of this name without specifying its argument list.
RoutineBySignature public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineSelects a routine by its ordered argument declarations, including an explicit empty signature.
RoutineParameter public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineAn argument's declared type, direction, optional name, and set-valued type request.
ZeroArgumentAggregate public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\RoutineSelects an aggregate without arguments, represented by the SQL star signature.
AssignmentStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyA SET statement in a stored program that assigns at least one local variable or NEW trigger column, in written order. Other items of the same SET keep their ordinary setting and user-variable forms.
BlockStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyA BEGIN ... END compound statement: local declarations visible to its ordered statements.
ConditionalBranch public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyA guarded statement list: an IF or ELSEIF condition, a searched CASE condition, or a simple CASE comparison value.
EmbeddedStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyAn ordinary MySQL statement run from a stored program body, bound with the same semantic forms as direct SQL.
IfStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyIF ... ELSEIF ... ELSE ... END IF: runs the statements of the first branch whose condition is true, otherwise the ELSE statements.
IterateStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyITERATE label: starts the next pass of the enclosing loop with that label.
LeaveStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyLEAVE label: exits the enclosing block or loop with that label.
LoopStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyLOOP ... END LOOP: repeats its statements until LEAVE or RETURN exits.
RepeatStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyREPEAT ... UNTIL condition END REPEAT: runs its statements, then stops once the condition is true.
ReturnStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyRETURN expression: ends a stored function with its result.
SearchedCaseStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyCASE WHEN condition THEN ... END CASE: runs the statements of the first true WHEN condition. Without ELSE, no true condition raises the case-not-found condition when the program runs.
SelectIntoStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodySELECT ... INTO targets in a stored program, storing the single result row in local and user variables, one per column.
SimpleCaseStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyCASE operand WHEN value THEN ... END CASE: runs the statements of the first WHEN value equal to the operand. Without ELSE, no match raises the case-not-found condition when the program runs.
WhileStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\BodyWHILE condition DO ... END WHILE: runs its statements while the condition, tested before each pass, is true.
CursorCloseStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\CursorCLOSE cursor: releases an open declared cursor.
CursorFetchStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\CursorFETCH [[NEXT] FROM] cursor INTO variables: stores the cursor's next row in local variables.
CursorOpenStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\CursorOPEN cursor: runs the declared cursor's query.
ConditionDeclaration public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationDECLARE name CONDITION FOR value: names an error number or SQLSTATE for handlers and SIGNAL.
CursorDeclaration public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationDECLARE name CURSOR FOR query: a read-only cursor over the query's rows, opened later with OPEN.
DeclarationOrder @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationChecks the declaration order and name uniqueness MySQL requires within one BEGIN ... END block.
ErrorCode public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationA MySQL error number naming a condition, kept as written; the number 0 names no condition.
HandlerDeclaration public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationDECLARE action HANDLER FOR conditions statement: runs the statement when a listed condition is raised in the block.
LocalAssignment public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationSET variable = expression for a parameter or DECLAREd local variable.
LocalVariable public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationA routine parameter or DECLAREd local variable, the storage a local-variable reference names.
NamedCondition public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationA handled condition named by an enclosing DECLARE ... CONDITION.
TriggerRowAssignment public APISqlSemantics\Model\Definition\Routine\Body\DeclarationSET NEW.column = expression in a BEFORE trigger: changes the row about to be written.

Without RETURNING the result is a MySQL string or PostgreSQL text; without an ON EMPTY or ON ERROR response the database returns NULL.

AlterDomainNullabilityStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\DomainAdds (SET NOT NULL) or removes (DROP NOT NULL) the NOT NULL constraint of a domain.

DropDomainConstraintStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\DomainDrops one named constraint of a domain.
DropDomainDefaultStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\DomainRemoves the default value of a domain.
SetDomainDefaultStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\DomainSets the default value of a domain.
ValidateDomainConstraintStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\DomainValidates existing values against a domain constraint that was added NOT VALID.
CopyCollationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\LocaleCreates a collation with the settings of an existing collation.

RefreshCollationVersionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\LocaleRecords the current provider version of one collation.
AddOperatorFamilyMembersStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorAdds operators and support functions to an operator family; every operator names its operand types.
AlterOperatorStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorChanges the estimators, partners, or capabilities of an existing operator; a null estimator or partner is NONE.
CreateOperatorClassStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorCreates an operator class that lets an index access method index a type, optionally as the default class and within a named family.
CreateOperatorFamilyStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorCreates an empty operator family for an index access method.
CreateOperatorStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorCreates a prefix or binary operator implemented by a function, with its optional partners, estimators, and capabilities.
DropOperatorFamilyMembersStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorRemoves operators and support functions from an operator family.
DropOperatorSetStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorDrops one operator class or operator family of an index access method.
DropOperatorsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OperatorDrops operators, each selected by its symbol and operand types.
DropOwnedStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OwnershipSelects objects and privileges by their owners for removal.
ReassignOwnedStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\OwnershipSelects owned objects and a required new owner for ownership transfer.
GrantDefaultPrivilegesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\PrivilegeAdds default privileges for objects that the selected roles create later.
GrantPrivilegesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\PrivilegeGrants privileges on objects of one class to roles, optionally with the grant option.
GrantRolesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\PrivilegeGrants membership in roles, with optional admin, inherit, and set options.
RevokeDefaultPrivilegesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\PrivilegeRemoves default privileges, or only their grant option, for objects created later.
RevokePrivilegesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\PrivilegeRevokes privileges, or only their grant option, from roles with a dependent-grant policy.
RevokeRolesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\PrivilegeRevokes membership in roles, or only one membership option, with a dependent-grant policy.
AlterRelationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationApplies an ordered list of typed actions to a table, index, sequence, view, materialized view, or foreign table. Partition attachment and detachment stand alone; every other action can be combined.
CreateForeignPartitionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationDeclares a foreign table as a partition of a partitioned table, inheriting its columns and covering one bound.
CreateForeignTableStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationDeclares a foreign table from its own columns, template clauses, and parents, served by a foreign server.
MoveTablespaceRelationsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationMoves every table, index, or materialized view of one tablespace, optionally only those of given owners, into another tablespace.
RelationInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationShared operand rules of PostgreSQL commands that address one relation by name.
RenameRelationColumnStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationRenames one column of a table, view, materialized view, or foreign table.
RenameRelationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationGives a table, sequence, view, materialized view, index, or foreign table a new name in its schema.
RenameTableConstraintStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationRenames one constraint of a table; ONLY keeps constraints of descendant tables unchanged.
SetRelationSchemaStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RelationMoves a table, sequence, view, materialized view, or foreign table into another schema.
DropNamedObjectsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RemovalDrops access methods, extensions, languages, publications, or schemas by unqualified name. Servers, wrappers, and event triggers have their own removal statements.
DropRelationMemberStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RemovalDrops one policy or rule of a table; triggers use DropTableTriggerStatement.
DropRelationsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RemovalDrops sequences or foreign tables; tables, views, indexes, and materialized views have their own removal forms.
DropSchemaObjectsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RemovalDrops collations, conversions, statistics objects, or text search objects by qualified name.
DropTypesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RemovalDrops types or domains addressed by type declarations.
RemovalInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RemovalShared operand rules of PostgreSQL DROP forms with target lists.
AlterPublicationObjectsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationAdds objects to, replaces the objects of, or removes objects from a publication.
AlterPublicationOptionsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationChanges WITH options of a publication; unspecified options keep their values.
AlterSubscriptionConnectionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationReplaces the connection string of a subscription.
AlterSubscriptionEnabledStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationEnables or disables a subscription's replication.
AlterSubscriptionOptionsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationChanges WITH options of a subscription; unspecified options keep their values.
AlterSubscriptionPublicationsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationReplaces, adds to, or removes from the publications of a subscription, optionally refreshing its tables.
CreateAllTablesPublicationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationCreates a publication of every table in the database, including tables created later.
CreateObjectsPublicationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationCreates a publication of listed tables and schemas.
CreatePublicationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationCreates a publication that publishes no table until objects are added.
CreateSubscriptionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationCreates a subscription to publications of another server, reached through a connection string that is not parsed.
DropSubscriptionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationRemoves a subscription and, while connected, its replication slot.
RefreshSubscriptionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationFetches the current table list of a subscription's publications.
SkipSubscriptionTransactionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ReplicationSkips applying the remote transaction that finishes at a log sequence number, or clears a previous skip with NONE.
AddGroupMembersStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleThe legacy group form that adds members of a role.
AlterRoleResetAllStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleRemoves every stored session default for a role selection, optionally within one database.
AlterRoleResetStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleRemoves one stored session default for a role selection, optionally within one database.
AlterRoleSetStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleStores a session default for one role or every role, optionally within one database.
AlterRoleStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleChanges the attributes of an existing role; ALTER USER binds to the same operation.
CreateRoleStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleDefines a new role, user, or group with typed attributes and initial memberships.
DropGroupMembersStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleThe legacy group form that removes members of a role.
DropRolesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleRemoves named roles; DROP USER and DROP GROUP bind to the same operation.
RenameRoleStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\RoleRenames a role; ALTER USER and ALTER GROUP RENAME bind to the same operation.
CreateAuthorizationSchemaStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\SchemaCreates a PostgreSQL schema named after and owned by a role, optionally populated by nested commands.
CreateSchemaStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\SchemaCreates a named PostgreSQL schema, optionally owned by another role and populated by nested commands.
CreatePartitionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TableDeclares a table as a partition of a partitioned table: it takes the parent's columns, covers one bound, and may override columns, add constraints, and be partitioned itself.
CreateTypedTableStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TableDeclares a typed table whose columns are the attributes of a composite type; the declaration may override those columns and add constraints.
TableFormInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TableOperand rules shared by the PostgreSQL table forms whose columns come from elsewhere: a partition and a typed table.
AlterPolicyStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\Table\PolicyChanges the roles or expressions of a row security policy; an absent operand keeps its current value.
CreatePolicyStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\Table\PolicyDefines a row security policy of a table: which rows the listed roles can see and which new rows they can write.
CreateCommandRuleStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\Table\RuleCreates a rewrite rule that runs commands in addition to, or instead of, the matching command.
CreateEmptyRuleStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\Table\RuleCreates a rewrite rule that does nothing, so with INSTEAD it suppresses the matching command.
CreateTablespaceStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TablespaceRequests a PostgreSQL tablespace at a server directory, optionally owned by another role and with parameter overrides.

SetTablespaceOptionsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TablespaceOverrides planner cost or I/O concurrency parameters for relations stored in a PostgreSQL tablespace.
AlterTextSearchDictionaryStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchSets or removes template options of a text search dictionary; an option without an argument is removed.
CopyTextSearchConfigurationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchCreates a text search configuration with the parser and mappings of an existing configuration.
CreateTextSearchConfigurationStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchCreates an empty text search configuration for a parser.
CreateTextSearchDictionaryStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchCreates a text search dictionary from a template and the options that template interprets.

CreateTextSearchTemplateStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchCreates a text search template from its lexize function and an optional init function.
DropTextSearchMappingStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchRemoves the mappings of token types from a text search configuration.
MapTextSearchTokensStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchMaps token types of a text search configuration to an ordered dictionary list, adding mappings or replacing existing ones.
ReplaceTextSearchDictionaryStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchReplaces one dictionary with another in the mappings of a text search configuration, for the listed token types or, when none are listed, for every token type.
TextSearchInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TextSearchOperand rules shared by text search configuration mappings.
AlterEventTriggerFiringStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerChanges the replication contexts that can fire a named event trigger.
ChangeEventTriggerOwnerStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerTransfers a named event trigger to a required role identity.
CreateConstraintTriggerStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerCreates an AFTER row trigger whose firing can be deferred like a constraint check.
CreateEventTriggerStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerCreates a database-wide trigger that runs a function on a DDL, rewrite, or login event, optionally only for some command tags.
CreateTriggerStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerCreates or replaces a PostgreSQL trigger that runs a function when a table changes.
DropEventTriggersStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerRequests removal of named event triggers and records dependent-object behavior.
RenameEventTriggerStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TriggerRenames an event trigger with a required replacement identity.
AddEnumLabelStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeAdds a label to an enum type, at the end or next to an existing label.
AlterCompositeTypeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeAdds, drops, and retypes attributes of a composite type in one command.
AlterTypeOptionsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeChanges the optional support functions or the storage strategy of a base type; a null function is NONE.
CreateBaseTypeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeCompletes a base type with its input and output functions and its optional support functions and storage properties.
CreateCompositeTypeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeCreates a composite type from an ordered list of uniquely named attributes, which may be empty.
CreateEnumTypeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeCreates an enum type from its ordered, unique labels, which may be empty.
CreateRangeTypeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeCreates a range type over a subtype, with its optional operator class, collation, canonical and difference functions, and multirange name.
CreateShellTypeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeCreates a shell type: a placeholder name that a later base type definition completes.
RenameEnumLabelStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\TypeRenames one label of an enum type to a different label.
CreateMaterializedViewStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ViewDeclares a query whose result rows are stored and read like a table until refreshed.
DropMaterializedViewsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ViewRemoves stored materialized views; ordinary views use their own removal form.
RefreshMaterializedViewStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\PostgreSql\ViewRequests recomputation of a materialized view's stored rows from its query.
AlterRoutineStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\RoutineChanges attributes of an existing PostgreSQL function, procedure, or routine; RESTRICT is noise. A procedure accepts only SECURITY, SET, and RESET; for ROUTINE the server applies the rules of the object it finds.

CreateTableFunctionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\RoutineCreates or replaces a function that returns a set of rows with named columns (RETURNS TABLE).
RoutineInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\RoutineRules shared by the PostgreSQL routine definition statements.
AlterSequenceStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\SequenceChanges the options of an existing sequence; RESTART sets the next value and omitted options keep their current settings.
CreateSequenceStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\SequenceCreates a sequence generator; omitted options take the server defaults for the type and direction.
SequenceInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\SequenceThe option rules PostgreSQL applies to CREATE SEQUENCE and ALTER SEQUENCE.
CreateExpressionStatisticsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\StatisticsDefines univariate statistics on one expression of a table; this form accepts no statistics kinds.
CreateStatisticsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\StatisticsDefines multivariate statistics over two to eight distinct columns and expressions of one table. An empty kind list requests every statistics kind; a column is a column reference, anything else an expression.
SetStatisticsTargetStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\StatisticsSets the sampling target of an extended statistics object; -1, also spelled DEFAULT, restores the system default.
StatisticsInvariant @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Definition\StatisticsShared rules of PostgreSQL extended statistics objects.
DoBlockStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\ExecutionRuns a PostgreSQL anonymous code block; binding records the code as a text constant and never runs it. Without a language the server uses plpgsql.
DoExpressionsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\ExecutionA MySQL request to evaluate scalar expressions and discard their results.
InsertDefaultValuesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InsertInsertion of one row using destination defaults.
InsertSelectStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InsertInsertion from exactly one source query.
InsertSetStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InsertInsertion from ordered column assignments.
InsertValuesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InsertInsertion from an explicit VALUES row list.
InspectedTable @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InspectionValidates the single physical table an inspection describes.

ShowPrivilegesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InspectionRequests privilege definitions and their applicable object contexts.
ShowProcessesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\InspectionRequests visible connection activity, with an explicit SQL-text truncation policy.
ShowCreateDatabaseStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE DATABASE statement that would recreate a database, optionally written with IF NOT EXISTS.
ShowCreateEventStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE statement that would recreate an event.
ShowCreateFunctionStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE statement that would recreate a function.
ShowCreateProcedureStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE statement that would recreate a procedure.
ShowCreateTableStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE TABLE statement that would recreate a table.
ShowCreateTriggerStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE statement that would recreate a trigger.
ShowCreateUserStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE USER statement that would recreate an account; the result label carries the account as written.
ShowCreateViewStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionReturns the CREATE VIEW statement that would recreate a view; the view is resolved like a table.
ShowRoutineCodeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionLists the compiled instructions of a stored function or stored procedure.
ShowRoutineStatusStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\DefinitionLists stored functions or stored procedures with their characteristics.
LogEventPosition @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationChecks the start position of a log event listing.
ReplicationChannel @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationChecks the FOR CHANNEL operand of replication inspections.
ShowBinaryLogEventsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationLists the events of one binary log file from a start position.
ShowBinaryLogStatusStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationReports the current binary log file and position; SHOW MASTER STATUS is the spelling of releases before 8.4.
ShowBinaryLogsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationLists the binary log files on the server; SHOW MASTER LOGS is a synonym.
ShowRelayLogEventsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationLists the events of one relay log file of a replication channel from a start position.
ShowReplicaStatusStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationReports the state of the replica threads of one channel or of every channel; SHOW SLAVE STATUS returns the same fields under legacy labels.
ShowReplicasStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ReplicationLists the replicas registered with this source; SHOW SLAVE HOSTS returns the same fields under legacy labels.

ShowCharacterSetsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists available character sets.
ShowCollationsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists available collations.
ShowColumnsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaDescribes the columns of a table; FULL adds collation, privileges, and comment, and EXTENDED includes hidden columns.
ShowDatabasesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists the databases visible to the current account.
ShowEventsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists scheduled events of a database.
ShowIndexesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists the indexes of a table; EXTENDED includes hidden key parts. Only a WHERE condition can restrict the listing.
ShowOpenTablesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists tables currently open in the table cache.
ShowTableStatusStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaReports storage facts for each table of a database.
ShowTablesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists the tables and views of a database; FULL adds the object type and EXTENDED includes hidden tables.
ShowTriggersStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SchemaLists triggers of a database.
ShowEngineReportStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ServerRequests a status, mutex, or log report from one storage engine or from every engine.
ShowParseTreeStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ServerReturns the server's parse tree of a statement as JSON without executing it; available from MySQL 8.1.
ShowProfileStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ServerReports the execution stages of one profiled statement, with the requested resource categories.
ShowProfilesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\ServerLists the most recent profiled statements of the session.
ShowDiagnosticCountStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SessionCounts the conditions the previous statement left in the diagnostics area, without clearing them.
ShowDiagnosticsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SessionLists the conditions the previous statement left in the diagnostics area, without clearing them.
ShowGrantsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SessionReturns the GRANT statements that reproduce an account's privileges, optionally as if the listed roles were active.
ShowStatusStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SessionLists the server's status counters with their values in one scope.
ShowVariablesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Inspection\SessionLists the server's system variables with their values in one scope.
BulkLoadStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingLoads delimited text into a table with the bulk loader (LOAD DATA ... ALGORITHM = BULK). The bulk loader reads server, URL or S3 sources, maps fields to every column in order, and takes an exclusive table lock, so LOCAL, column lists, SET, IGNORE, LINES STARTING BY and lock scheduling do not apply.
FieldLayout public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingThe FIELDS clause of a load: field terminator, enclosing quote and escape character; null keeps the server default.
ImportTableStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingImports MyISAM tables from serialized dictionary information files; each pattern names .sdi files on the server.
LineLayout public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingThe LINES clause of a load: the row terminator (for XML, the row element name) and the prefix skipped before each row.
LoadFileStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingInserts the rows of a text or XML file into a table (LOAD DATA or LOAD XML without ALGORITHM = BULK). Without BULK the server ignores IN PRIMARY KEY ORDER, PARALLEL and MEMORY, so they are not retained.
LoadLayout public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingHow a load reads its input: character set, field and line separators, and the number of leading rows skipped.
LoadLibraryStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingLoads a PostgreSQL shared library into the session; binding records the file name and never opens it.
LoadTargets @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingValidates the operands MySQL loads share: the file name, the receiving columns or user variables and the SET assignments.
SeparatorText @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LoadingDecodes the string, hexadecimal and bit literals that spell load separators to the bytes the server compares.
CopyFromStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyLoads rows into a table from a server file, a server program or the client; binding reads no data.
CopyOptionRules @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyThe option combinations the server's COPY option reader rejects.
CopyOptions public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyThe options of COPY with their server defaults; null marks an option left to its format default. Legacy keyword options such as CSV HEADER or DELIMITER AS ',' bind to the same options as the parenthesized list.
CopyQueryStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyWrites the rows a query returns to a server file, a server program or the client; binding runs neither the query nor the copy. A data-modifying query must return rows with RETURNING.
CopyTable @visibility SqlSemanticsSqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyValidates the table and column operands shared by COPY FROM and COPY TO.
CopyToStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyWrites the rows of a table to a server file, a server program or the client; binding writes no data.
EveryColumn public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyApplies a COPY FORCE option to every copied column, written as an asterisk.
ListedColumns public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\CopyApplies a COPY FORCE option to the listed columns.
CopyClient public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\Copy\EndpointThe client connection: STDIN for COPY FROM and STDOUT for COPY TO.
CopyFile public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\Copy\EndpointA file on the database server, named by a text constant; binding never opens it.
CopyProgram public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\Loading\Copy\EndpointA shell command run by the database server, given as a text constant; binding never runs it.
LockInstanceStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LockingTakes the instance-level backup lock, which blocks file-changing DDL while DML continues.
LockRelationsStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LockingAcquires ordered PostgreSQL relation locks in one mode for the current transaction.
LockTablesStatement public APISqlSemantics\Model\Statement\LockingAcquires MySQL session table locks with an independent access mode for each occurrence.
